have not seen. Choose read the survey log to read
back your last 8 soundings.

stone that carries a sounding (12 to 30 paces, by
the floor); the rod in your pack.

terrain, never creatures or things, and nothing
nearer than 4 paces. It uses nothing up.

sections.heading: Decision details
sections.text:
You see a sounding rod.
How to use: Press C on your own cell and choose sound the ground (or choose it from the pack). The stone answers with a bearing and a distance for open ground, a way up or down, or dense stone you have not seen. Choose read the survey log to read back your last 8 soundings.
Needs: an ordinary cave floor below the surface, in stone that carries a sounding (12 to 30 paces, by the floor); the rod in your pack.
Cost and limits: The strike rings through the stone: eyeless hunters hear it. It names only terrain, never creatures or things, and nothing nearer than 4 paces. It uses nothing up.
Right now you cannot: read the survey log (You have not sounded anything with this rod yet), sound the ground (The ground up here is too loose to carry a sounding).

An iron-shod ash rod with a striking collar.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 4. Total weight: 4.
Lift Strength: 3; yours: 70.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
sounding rod cannot be thrown.
Pack weight: 428; with this item: 428. Burden threshold: 1050.
